description: Frozen teaching datasets for Tutorial V; notebooks require no live downloads.

market.source: Kenneth French Data Library, daily Fama/French research factors
market.units: Decimal daily simple returns. market_return = Mkt-RF + RF.
market.definition: Broad value-weighted US CRSP equity market, including distributions; not an index price series.
market.notebook_analysis_sample: 2021-01-04 to 2025-12-31; 1,255 trading sessions; one contiguous sample after 2020
market.notebook_transform: 100 * log(1 + market_return); observations ordered by trading session; no holiday filling

gnp.table: NIPA 1.7.6, quarterly worksheet T10706-Q, line 4, BEA code A001RX
gnp.source_units: Millions of chained 2017 USD, seasonally adjusted annual rate
gnp.csv_units: Billions of chained 2017 USD, seasonally adjusted annual rate; source levels divided by 1000
gnp.level_sample: 1947Q1-2025Q4 (316 quarters); first quarter supplies the growth base
gnp.main_analysis_sample: 1947Q2-2019Q4 (291 growth quarters); candidate models use the same 283 quarters, 1949Q2-2019Q4, with hold_back=8
gnp.transform: 100 * diff(log(real_gnp)); quarterly log growth, not annualised
gnp.forecast: One-step historical forecasts of 2020Q1 from origin 2019Q4 using AR(1) and AR(3); observed 2020Q1 is held out of estimation and selection.
gnp.sensitivity_sample: Extend the contiguous growth sample through 2025Q4 (315 observations)
gnp.vintage: Revised values available on retrieval date, not a real-time vintage or an exact replication of historical papers
gnp.copyright: Public-domain BEA data; BEA/FRED attribution retained
gnp.notebook_scope: Compare AR(1) selected by BIC and AR(3) selected by AIC on the same pre-2020 sample; impulse responses and period/damping of the AR(3) complex mode, not average observed business-cycle duration.
